chapter_title: The main theorem and its scope
name: Nonconvex exclusion for simple pentagons of fixed area
statement_markdown: Every nonconvex simple polygon $P\in\mathscr P_{\le5}(A)$ of area $A>0$ admits a simple polygon $Q$ of the same area with at most five active sides such that $\lambda_1(Q)<\lambda_1(P)$. If the admissible class requires exactly five active sides, $Q$ can also be chosen with exactly five active sides. Consequently, any global minimizer in either fixed-area class, if it exists, is convex. The admissible classes and spectral functional are those of @def-domain.
